messages.subject: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1144261: Bug: r-bioc-genomicfeatures 1.64.0 contains .so files, needs Architecture: any instead of all
messages.subject_clean: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1144261: Bug: r-bioc-genomicfeatures 1.64.0 contains .so files, needs Architecture: any instead of all
messages.body_plain:
Source: r-bioc-genomicfeatures
Version: 1.64.0+dfsg-1
Severity: normal
Tags: sid
User: debian-loongarch at lists.debian.org
Usertags: loong64


Hi all,

I found that version 1.64.0 of r-bioc-genomicfeatures contains GenomicFeatures.so files, which has caused compilation errors in some software.

https://buildd.debian.org/status/package.php?p=r-bioc-isoformswitchanalyzer&suite=sid
https://buildd.debian.org/status/package.php?p=r-bioc-variantannotation&suite=sid
https://buildd.debian.org/status/package.php?p=r-bioc-variantannotation&suite=sid

$ dpkg -c r-bioc-genomicfeatures_1.64.0+dfsg-1_all.deb | grep GenomicFeatures.so
-rw-r--r-- root/root    149624 2026-08-11 22:15 ./usr/lib/R/site-library/GenomicFeatures/libs/GenomicFeatures.so

Please update Architecture: all to Architecture: any within the debian/control file.
Thanks!
